articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated resale luxury goods, today announced the appointment of Sharmistha "Shar" Dubey, former Chief Executive Officer of Match Group, to its Board of Directors, effective November 3, 2026. "We are pleased to welcome Shar to The RealReal's Board," said Karen Katz, Chair of the Board. "She brings a thoughtful, strategic perspective and a strong commitment to governance that will further strengthen our Board as we guide the company through its next chapter." Dubey brings more than two decades of leadership experience in technology, product innovation and scaling global consumer businesses. As CEO of Match Group, she oversaw a portfolio of leading digital brands, including Tinder, Hinge, Match and OkCupid, and, before her time as CEO, held several senior leadership roles at the company, including President, Chief Operating Officer of Tinder, President of Match Group Americas and Chief Product Officer of Match
articles.title: The RealReal Appoints Shar Dubey to Board of Directors
